Experience with Git, Maven/Gradle, and CI/CD tools. Excellent analytical, communication, and leadership skills. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. Mandatory Requirements 7+ years of relevant Java development experience. Oracle skillset is mandatory. Valid Passport is mandatory. Must be willing to travel internationally as required.
